mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, category, priority, status, created_at FROM tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, category, priority, status, created_at FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (user_id, title, category, priority, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{status})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '进行中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '未开始' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS notStarted FROM tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId}
